Un petit ibis sur son socle, à l'image d: A small ibis on its base, in the image of Thoth, the Egyptian god of science, wisdom and writing. He is often shown as an ibis or a baboon. The tree in the cave left it to you.
Thot est le dieu des scribes. On disait: Thoth is the god of scribes. He was said to have invented hieroglyphs.
